text: Replacement of Obsolete Data Types from Oracle and MSSQL Databases Training on this feature is available onOracle University. This feature provides a utility to convert obsolete Column types, such as Oracle's LONG and Microsoft SQL Server's TEXT/NTEXT to their modern equivalents: CLOBs and VARCHAR(max)/NVARCHAR(max). The driver behind this is that the respective database vendors deprecated these data types a number of years ago and modern database engines are no longer being optimized for these older types. Replacing them with their modern equivalents will take advantage of their inherent benefits, such as greater data storage space, as well as future-proofing should either vendor ever elect to completely end support for these. • Database Upgrade Guide • Business Process Framework: Workfow Guide • Confguring Siebel Business Applications • Integration Platform Technologies: Siebel Enterprise Application Integration Guide No
